summary: Foreign Trade Bank of Latin America (Bladex) filed a Form 6-K on June 23, 2026, reporting that S&P Global Ratings upgraded its long-term issuer credit rating to BBB+ from BBB, with a stable outlook, and its Tier 1 hybrid notes to BB from BB-. The upgrade is attributed to the bank's strong risk profile, asset quality, earnings, capitalization, and liquidity. This is a routine credit rating announcement, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, board actions, or advisor involvement. No risk-arb angle applies; it is purely a credit event.
